name: Ancient Forge
desc:
According to ancient legend, a giant monster might attack us at any moment!
How will the lonely city of Lungmen manage to survive an astonishing explosion and make it to the new year?
The red-hot blockbuster 'Lungmen Doomwatch'... No, we'll call it 'Ancient Forge'!
Anyway, look forward to it!

infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: A new celebration approaches and Lungmen is vigorously making preparations, waiting for a faceless enemy only known by the name, 'Nian.'

The enemy's arrival brings great chaos and confusion, but fortunately, many passionate citizens team up with the L.G.D. to fight back the enemy. Behind the scenes, the true enemy has already bared her fangs, but in front of her stands the Catastrophe expert, Lava.

In order to reclaim the city from Nian, Rhodes Island and Lungmen join forces to make a desperate move. Just when the battle is about to reach its climax... the director decides to interrupt everything.
